description: Frozen importers of legacy sync modules scheduled for retirement (plan C class (a)). May only shrink. Owned by tests/unit/test_sync_legacy_import_ratchet.py.

importers.scripts/recover_dev_failed_sync_backfill: Dev-only operator recovery for the backfill sequencer; deleted with the sequencer in C10.
importers.scripts/repair_sync_backfill_owners.py: Operator repair for sequencer owner rows; deleted with the sequencer in C10.
importers.scripts/staging/syncsplit.py: Staging-only sync pull-worker control-plane proof drives the sequencer registry directly as its subject; retires with the sequencer in C10.
importers.utils/sync/worker_control.py: Legacy backfill worker control plane claims and releases jobs through the sequencer registry; deleted with the sequencer in C10.

importers.database/sync_jobs.py: Legacy Redis sync job records write dead letters on terminal failure; both retire with legacy transcription (C10/C11).
importers.utils/sync/worker_job.py: Legacy worker terminal cleanup confirms the failed job dead letter before retiring state; deleted with the dead-letter store in C10.

importers.utils/sync/recording_session_target.py: Function-local import of uid_hash for privacy-safe failure logging only; C10 replaces it with a shared hash helper when backfill_cutover is deleted.

importers.utils/cloud_tasks.py: Shared Cloud Tasks client computes direct backfill schedule_at; the call is cut when sync-backfill is deleted in C10.

importers.utils/sync/empty_success_guard.py: Empty-success guard inspects strict empty recovery via inspect_strict when its lever is on; retires with legacy empty recovery in C11.

importers.scripts/cap_hold_durability_emulator_tes: Loopback cap-hold durability proof drives legacy pipeline restart as its crash-recovery subject; retires with cap-hold-on-legacy in C11.
importers.testing/e2e/test_sync_lifecycle.py: Hermetic e2e for the legacy sync lifecycle; deleted with legacy transcription in C11.
importers.testing/e2e/test_watch_recovery_process_: Hermetic e2e for watch-driven process-now recovery exercises the legacy sync pipeline as its subject; deleted with legacy transcription in C11.
importers.testing/replay_harness_phase0a/apps.py: Replay harness serves the legacy sync worker; drop the legacy app in C11.
importers.testing/sync_cloud_tasks_stack/app.py: Gauntlet (GA) stack serves the legacy sync worker; drop it in C11 once the gauntlet is batch-only.
importers.utils/sync/cap_hold_recovery.py: Cap-hold core (a C11 survivor) drives legacy pipeline transcription for held-audio recovery; C11 re-points recovery at the batch pipeline.
importers.utils/sync/cap_recovery_audio.py: Cap-hold audio replay borrows legacy VAD retrieval and cleanup; C11 swaps these helpers for batch-pipeline equivalents.
importers.utils/sync/worker_job.py: Legacy worker job drives pipeline download/run/delete-staged-blobs for transcription execution and cleanup; re-pointed or deleted when legacy transcription retires in C11.

importers.utils/sync/cap_recovery_audio.py: Held-capture replay replays ordinary WAL/safety-WAL coverage via the legacy appliers; C11 replaces them with batch-pipeline coverage reporting.

importers.utils/other/storage.py: Storage download path consumes legacy staged prefetch bytes; cut when the sequencer prefetch is deleted in C10.

importers.scripts/recover_dev_failed_sync_backfill: Dev-only operator recovery kicks the sequencer; deleted with the sequencer in C10.
importers.utils/sync/worker_control.py: Legacy worker control kicks the per-uid sequencer after releasing a claim; both are legacy-worker machinery retired in C10.

importers.utils/capture/batch_coverage.py: Batch capture coverage reuses the WAL coverage frame-map builder while the coverage lane shadows the WAL; retires with wal_audio_coverage in C11.
importers.utils/capture/sync_coverage.py: Sync capture coverage materializes audio through the WAL coverage materializer during the S1 shadow; retires with wal_audio_coverage in C11.
